title: Servepath latency-bridge cohortboard with streaming vs non-streaming traces
creator: Marco Varela
description: Build an end-to-end dashboard (latency-bridge cohortboard) that exposes p50/p95/p99 latency and tail behavior by model + route, with an explicit streaming vs non-streaming cohort breakdown. The board should provide fast links to traces, error overlays, and a small set of lightweight alertable metrics so platform and SRE can detect drifts in IO-mode performance and investigate with trace context.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Dashboard surfaces p50/p95/p99 for every model x route x io_mode (streaming, non_streaming) for the last 1h/24h/7d.
2) Each cohort tile has a link that opens a filtered trace view (trace hook parameters: servepath_id, request_shape, io_mode).
3) Error-rate overlay and top-5 error signatures correlated with tail latency visible per cohort.
4) Metric rollups run as aggregations in the metrics pipeline (no high-cardinality joins at query-time).
5) SLO/alert panels: p99 > 2s for non_streaming OR p95 > 500ms for streaming triggers a PagerDuty alerting rule (configurable).
6) Dashboard passes load test queries against prod-staging with <1s load time for 7d window and <3s for 30d window.
implementation_notes:
Telemetry: add explicit tags to tracing and metrics: model_name, route_name, servepath_id, io_mode (values: streaming|non_streaming), request_shape_bucket.
Metrics pipeline: pre-aggregate token-latency_histogram and count/error by (model_name, route_name, io_mode, time_bucket). Use existing aggregation workers; add a new aggregation job 'latency_bridge_aggregator' with retention 30d.
Logs: enrich request logs with servepath_id and io_mode for quick join in the log pipeline.
Dashboard layout: top row global summary (all models), middle rows: per-model collapsible grid, right column: trace quick-links + top error signatures + ticketed regressions list.
Queries: use deduped aggregation keys to keep cardinality bounded, sample traces at 1% per servepath but bump to 10% when p99 exceeds threshold.
Backwards compatibility: dashboard should gracefully show 'io_mode: unknown' for older events and exclude them from streaming/non_streaming cohorts.
telemetry_changes:
1) Trace spans: add attribute 'servepath.id' and 'io_mode' to root request span.
2) Metrics: emit histogram buckets for request_latency_ms with labels model, route, io_mode.
3) Aggregator: new rollup job to compute p50/p95/p99 per minute and store as timeseries.
4) Sampling: adaptive trace sampling triggered by p95/p99 anomalies.
5) Backfill: run a one-off aggregator run over last 30d to bootstrap new panels.
dashboard_panels: Global summary: p50/p95/p99 trendline (1h/24h/7d) with streaming vs non-streaming stacked bars
Model grid: per-model small-multiples showing p50/p95/p99 and stream/non-stream split
Route heatmap: p99 amplification ratio (current / baseline) with click-to-filter
Tail-traces panel: sample of traces for selected cohort with direct link to trace explorer
Error overlay: error-rate (5xx) timeseries with top error messages and % of tail latency contribution
Alert status: active SLO violations and recent reconciliations
Latency distribution: bucketed histogram for selected model-route-io_mode and time window
Compare mode: streaming vs non_streaming delta panel (p95 delta, p99 delta, error delta)
rollout_plan:
1) Implement telemetry changes behind feature flag and deploy to prod-staging.
2) Run aggregated backfill for last 30d.
3) Deploy dashboard to internal team alpha and collect feedback for 72h.
4) Widen to platform SRE for 7-day bake.
5) Flip feature flag and enable adaptive sampling.
6) Publish dashboard to customer-facing console for Dedicated tier as opt-in.
risks_and_mitigations:
Risk: cardinality explosion if model+route+servepath used naively. Mitigation: pre-aggregate and cap servepath_id cardinality; roll up to route-level for historical queries.
Risk: trace storage blowup with higher sampling. Mitigation: adaptive sampling and short-term higher retention only during incidents.
Risk: dashboard query times slow on long windows. Mitigation: add materialized p99/p95 time series in metrics store.
testing_plan: Unit tests for aggregator, end-to-end playbook in prod-staging with synthetic requests across streaming and non-streaming code paths, dashboard load test with synthetic query generator, QA checklist for trace links and error overlay correctness.
